name: Fu-shi-da-ra
source:
Our girl is one of those people who can't even think of H stuff. When she start to have exciting thoughts about her boyfriend(our guy), she has to seek counselling. What she got were some tapes and a bottle of perfume. While watching the tapes and inhaling a drop or two of that perfume, she has fun dreams with her boyfriend, guided by one of her friends. After a few sessions, she just might gain enough experience to live a happy life with our guy.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
女主人公属于那种连色情之事都不敢想象的人。每当她开始对男友（男主人公）产生令人兴奋的念头，就不得不寻求心理咨询。咨询中，她拿到几盘录像带和一瓶香水。观看录像、吸入一两滴香水的气味后，她会在一名朋友引导下，梦见自己与男友共度欢愉时光。经过几次治疗，她或许就能积累足够经验，与男主人公过上幸福生活。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150502131520/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
